## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-gov`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-gov -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `items.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `NOTICE`
- `gov.json`
- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `items.jsonl`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `axis-live.jsonl`
- `results_2026-08-11.json`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-gov at revision `9fea8a98dfab96f469097f1033975f12af47feb9`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# GSPC — governance bank (GovBench)



**In one line:** The frozen EU AI Act risk-tier classification bank (GovBench) behind the board's `governance` axis. For evaluators who want to test a model on the same items.

### Use it

```python
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("csoai/gspc-gov", split="train")
print(ds[0])
```

- **Verify a signed card in your browser, free, no account:** [https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/?ref=hf-gspc-gov](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/?ref=hf-gspc-gov)
- **For agents:** MCP endpoint `POST https://councilof.ai/mcp` (free read tools; call `tools/list`).
- **A row about you is wrong, or you want an endpoint left out?** Ask for a re-check or object: [https://councilof.ai/census/?ref=hf-gspc-gov](https://councilof.ai/census/?ref=hf-gspc-gov)

### Fresh data

This Hub copy is a dated snapshot. If it disagrees with the live source, the live source wins.

- `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=governance` (free, live, this dataset's row of the board)
- Signed transparency root (Merkle, board key `did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1`): https://councilof.ai/root.json
- Daily signed index of every measurement capsule: [https://councilof.ai/measurement-capsules/](https://councilof.ai/measurement-capsules/?ref=hf-gspc-gov) (also published on the Hub as [csoai/evidence-index](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/evidence-index))
- **Pay per call for a fresh, signed capsule:** `GET https://councilof.ai/api/request-attestation?subject=MODEL_ID` returns an x402 payment challenge for a signed, content-addressed commission receipt for one named model.
- Payment terms are published only in [https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json](https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json); this card quotes no price. Payment buys delivery and freshness, never a result, and verifying anything stays free.

### Cite

```bibtex
@misc{csoai_gspc_gov,
  title        = {GSPC — governance bank (GovBench)},
  author       = {{CSOAI Ltd (Council of AI)}},
  year         = {2026},
  publisher    = {Hugging Face},
  url          = {https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-gov},
  note         = {Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21991104: UNAVAILABLE since 29 Sep 2026 (Zenodo blocked the CSOAI account; appeal pending; status https://councilof.ai/interop/zenodo-status.json). Cite the served methodology: https://councilof.ai/signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY.md. Measurement, not certification.}
}
```

Measurement, not certification. This card adds no score or ranking of any company. A row marked UNMEASURED has not been measured; it is not a pass.




**Bank (governance).** Frozen split. Live `n` is the `governance` row on `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`, not a Hub leaderboard score. **Not a certificate.**

Art 50 dates (EUR-Lex): 2 August 2026 live; marking grace 2 December 2026.

Council of AI measurement bank. Measurement, not certification.


**Live measurement.** This bank stands behind the `governance` row of the live GSPC board: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=governance` (family, kind, status and n are on that row, never typed here; the whole board is `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`). Measurement, not certification.
